description: This file defines the Logger class within the OrangeHRM installer utilities. It provides a static method to retrieve a logger instance from the service container, which is used for logging within the installer component.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Provides a static method to access the logger service used for logging in the installer utilities.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns an instance of the framework's Logger class used for logging purposes.
